issues.description: validate_conda substring match on --version output mis-identifies any binary whose output contains 'conda' or 'mamba'
issues.detail: `any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in [...])` accepts any executable whose --version stdout contains those substrings. Match on the basename of the executable or the leading token of the version string instead of substring soup.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the file picker breaks Linux and macOS users
issues.detail: On POSIX systems conda/mamba/micromamba binaries are extensionless, so a hardcoded `*.exe` filter shows an empty file picker by default. Either platform-gate the filter or drop it, since validate_conda already enforces correctness.

issues.description: setFocus() side effect added to a shared browsefile helper affects every other caller
issues.detail: `select_file` in widgets/config.py now unconditionally calls `edit.setFocus()`, changing focus behavior for every preference page using create_browsefile. Make it opt-in via a parameter or do the setFocus in the conda caller, not in shared widget infrastructure.

issues.description: validate_conda runs an external subprocess on every keystroke and leaks/swallows diagnostics
issues.detail: If wired to textChanged, each keystroke spawns conda --version (hundreds of ms, blocks UI), and the bare `except Exception: return False` discards why validation failed. Debounce to editingFinished/focus-out and at minimum log the failure reason so users can debug their config.

issues.description: Empty-string sentinel plus custom_conda boolean encode the same state twice
issues.detail: `conda_path: ''` alongside a `custom_conda` flag is redundant, and validate_conda special-cases `""` as valid — effectively lying about empty strings. A single Optional[str] field (None means unset) would let the UI decide 'unset' and let the validator say False for 'not conda'.

issues.description: Kernelspec fallback nests conditionals without naming the invariant
issues.detail: The new fallback in argv() reads as nested gates: 'conda_exe is auto-detected, or the user-configured override iff custom_conda is enabled, or raise.' A flat helper like `conda_exe = find_conda() or _user_configured_conda()` plus a one-line comment stating that invariant would let future readers verify the logic at a glance.

synthesis.summary: The patch is small and well-scoped — a config flag, preferences widget, validator, and kernelspec fallback — but ships sloppy validation logic. The panel unanimously flags two P1 defects: substring matching on --version output that mis-identifies binaries, and a Windows-only `*.exe` file filter that breaks the picker on Linux and macOS. Secondary concerns center on a setFocus side effect leaking into a shared widget helper, per-keystroke subprocess cost with swallowed diagnostics, a redundant empty-string-plus-boolean config encoding, and an under-commented nested fallback in kernelspec. No P0 blockers; NEEDS-WORK before landing.
